title: The Forbidden Library
intro: Books breathe on the shelves. A reading lamp burns without oil. At the centre of the room a chained grimoire waits for the right code.

objects.label: Chained Atlas
objects.reward_text: A page falls open. A date is circled in red ink: 6.

objects.label: Whispering Bookcase
objects.reward_text: The bookcase tilts and a face is pressed against the other side.

a_atlas: This is a quick quiz of five reasoning questions. Read each one calmly.
You need 3 of the 5 right. The server keeps the clock, so do not dawdle.
If you fail you can try again with a fresh set of questions.
Answer the five questions and the reward shows a clue number. The vault's character number 1 is G.
b_lamp: Start with the biggest group size (9) and list the numbers that leave the right remainder.
Check each of those numbers against the other conditions.
The answer is 67. The vault's character number 2 is E.
c_catalogue: Find P and Q in your clue notes first.
Divide 42 by 11: it goes in 3 times.
The remainder is 9. The vault's characters number 3 and 4 are R and 2.
vault: The code has four characters. Some are letters, some are digits.
Each solved object revealed part of the code. Check the vault display.
The pieces go in the order they sit on the vault: Chained Atlas, Reading Lamp, Card Catalogue.
